title: bassia littorea
intro: Bassia littorea, commonly known as Saltwort or Glasswort, is a type of succulent halophyte plant that thrives in coastal salt marshes and beaches, particularly in tropical regions. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions due to its expectorant properties, which help relieve coughs and congestion. The therapeutic actions of Bassia littorea are attributed to its ability to stimulate the lymphatic system, promote diuresis, and exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
